notes: §1985:XIV.3.3.3 SR4: "Literal-1 or the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 must be defined as alphanumeric." CommunicationBinder#BindPath refuses COBOL6171 when #IsAlphanumericKey fails; a data item is asked of the REFERENCE (#IsCommunicationAlphanumericArea(Place), kb/Work PB5384): a reference-modified operand is the unique data item it creates, read through Table16Operand.Of(Place), so a slice of a numeric or numeric edited item is alphanumeric (§1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5) and a slice of a PIC A item stays alphabetic and is refused. Probes at --std 85 on this tree: ENABLE ... KEY K-NUM (1:2) and K-EDT (1:3) accepted and ran; PIC 9(4), PIC A, ZZ9 whole items refused as before. Open question carried from the read, not counted: PIC XXBXX (alphanumeric edited) is accepted while ZZ9.99 is refused.
